$comment: Negative half of the man-011/man-012 pair (#176 item 21). U+FEFF (ZERO WIDTH NO-BREAK SPACE) is white space under ECMA-262 and is rejected; some other regex dialects accept it. The second capability is written with a JSON escape so the code point is visible.
description: A Manifest offering a capability string that contains U+FEFF. U+FEFF is in the excluded set of registries/capabilities.md, so the value is outside its grammar and RFC-AITP-0003 §5 step 2 rejects the Manifest. Receivers MUST reject with MANIFEST_INVALID.

expected.rationale: U+FEFF is ECMA-262 white space, excluded by the capability pattern. A verifier whose regex dialect does not count it as white space accepts this Manifest and is non-conformant.
